responsibility: Implements a C++ compatibility layer that maps many VMX/Altivec-style vector intrinsics and predicates onto SPU intrinsics. Using overloaded inline functions and macros over the types from spu_intrinsics.h and vec_types.h, it re-expresses operations such as arithmetic, saturation, loads/stores, permutes, comparisons, and partial-vector memory accesses in terms of SPU builtin operations, enabling source-level migration of VMX code to the SPU programming model.
